name: Ozawa Maika
source:
[A brat who doesn't care about others as long as she's happy]

The older sister of the Ozawa sisters who entered the school on a sports recommendation. She shows great teamwork with her younger sister Aika during matches, but she hates practice and is not serious during club activities.

She is always a nuisance to Izuki and Hiroko.  She often flatters Junna and kisses up to her in order to get certain benefits,

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/himei/chara07.html]official site[/url]]
